  April 22, 2021



  The Honorable Anna Valencia
  Clerk of the City of Chicago
  121 North LaSalle Street
  Chicago, Illinois 60602

  RE: Intention to Vote Differently
      Ordinance 02021-445

  Clerk Valencia,

  I am writing in reference to Ordinance 02021-445, which is the issue pertaining to the motion to
  hold in Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards, to reclassify the area shown
  on Map No. 11-L at 4758 North Milwaukee Avenue (Application No 2061 ITl).

  I mistakenly voted "no". My intention was to vote "yes" in reference to the above ordinance.

  I request that this be recorded in the record as such. Please include this letter as part of the
  official record that I had meant to vote "yes" on this ordinance.

  Sincerely,




  David Moore
  Alderman, 17"* Ward
